This validates source/ABI/closure and optionally a private generated Ground

        # and arbitrary inline assembly cannot use it to bypass ISA validation.
        trap = re.search(r"(?ms)^SilverStarAssert_Fail:\s*\n(.*?)^[ \t]*\.size\s+"
                         r"SilverStarAssert_Fail\s*,", clean)
        if (not reviewed_assert_trap or trap is None or len(raw) != 1 or
                not trap.start(1) <= raw[0].start() < trap.end(1) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"\s*\.inst\s+0xdeff\s*", raw[0][0])):
            raise ValueError("Native raw instruction encoding requires a separately reviewed instruction contract")


def NativeArmAttributes_Validate(attributes: str, *, core: str, fpu: str, hard_float: bool,
                                 assembly: bool = False) -> None:
    tags = dict(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(Tag_\w+):\s*([^\r\n]+)", attributes))
    arch, thumb = {"cortex-m0": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m0plus": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m3": ("v7", "Thumb-2"),
                   "cortex-m4": ("v7E-M", "Thumb-2")}[core]
    profile = tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch_profile", "Microcontroller" if core in {"cortex-m0","cortex-m0plus"} else "")
    if (tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch") != arch or tags.get("Tag_THUMB_ISA_use") != thumb or
            profile != "Microcontroller"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM architecture attributes contradict independent core facts")
    if "Tag_ARM_ISA_use" in tags or "Tag_Advanced_SIMD_arch" in tags:
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires an unsupported instruction profile")
    if "Tag_FP_arch" in tags and (fpu != "fpv4-sp-d16" or tags["Tag_FP_arch"] != "VFPv4-D16"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating attributes contradict independent FPU facts")
    if "Tag_ABI_HardFP_use" in tags and tags["Tag_ABI_HardFP_use"] != "SP only":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires unsupported floating instructions")
    arguments = tags.get("Tag_ABI_VFP_args")
    if (arguments is not None and arguments != "VFP registers") or (arguments is not None and not hard_float):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating calling ABI contradicts native contract")
    if hard_float and not assembly and arguments != "VFP registers":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM C/ELF lacks its required hard-float calling ABI")


def NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector: bytes, symbols: str, slots: dict[str, int]) -> None:
    entries = {name: (int(address, 16), kind) for address, kind, name in
               re.findall(r"(?m)^([0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(\w)\s+(\w+)$", symbols)}
    if not slots:
        raise ValueError("Independent IRQn slots are missing")
    for handler, irqn in slots.items():
        if handler not in entries or entries[handler][1] != "T":
            raise ValueError("Independent IRQn has no strong compiled handler: " + handler)
        offset = (irqn + 16) * 4
        if (offset < 0 or offset + 4 > len(vector) or
                struct.unpack_from("<I", vector, offset)[0] != (entries[handler][0] | 1)):
            raise ValueError("Actual vector contradicts independent IRQn binding: " + handler)

    if (len(initializer) != 1 or re.fullmatch(r'\s*'+r'\s*,\s*'.join(names)+r'\s*,?\s*',initializer[0]) is None or

        raise ValueError('Native CDC initializer needs exact literal callback owners without expressions/aliases')

            ('CDC_DeInit_FS','return(USBD_OK);'),

        _start, opening, end = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(source, name)
        if re.sub(r'\s+','',NativeC_VisibleGet(source[opening+1:end-1])) != expected:

    source = _Function_Replace(source,'CDC_DeInit_FS','''static int8_t CDC_DeInit_FS(void)
{ PcByteStream_OnUsbReset(); return USBD_OK; }''')
    source = _Function_Replace(source,'CDC_Receive_FS','''static int8_t CDC_Receive_FS(uint8_t *Buf, uint32_t *Len)

}''')
    # A checked setter must not be bypassed by the stock application wrapper.
    field = 'pClassDataCmsit[0]' if indexed else 'pClassData'
    source = _Function_Replace(source,'CDC_Transmit_FS','''uint8_t CDC_Transmit_FS(uint8_t *Buf, uint16_t Len)
{

      (hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state != USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) ||
      (hUsbDeviceFS.'''+field+''' == NULL)) { return USBD_FAIL; }

  return (result == USBD_OK) ? USBD_OK : ((result == USBD_BUSY) ? USBD_BUSY : USBD_FAIL);

    if indexed:

{

  return (int8_t)USBD_OK;

        marker='  result = USBD_CDC_SetTxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS, Buf, Len);'

from silverstar_fccg.generator.ground_pc_usb_cdc import PcUsbCdc_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeC_FunctionSpanGet


def NativePcAdapter_Render(*, indexed: bool) -> str:
    adapter = PcUsbCdc_Render().replace('#include "pc_byte_stream.h"',
        '#include "pc_byte_stream.h"\n#include "native_runtime.h"\n#include "native_clock.h"', 1)
    marker = '    if ((hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state != USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) ||'
    if adapter.count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native PC publication gate owner changed')
    adapter = adapter.replace(marker, '    if (NativeRuntime_ReadyGet() == 0U)\n'
        '    { __set_PRIMASK(saved_mask); return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_BUSY; }\n'+marker, 1)
    start, _opening, end = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(adapter, 'PcByteStream_WriteSession')
    write = adapter[start:end]
    marker = '    saved_mask = __get_PRIMASK();'
    if write.count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native PC write context owner changed')
    write = write.replace(marker, '''    /* The native tick must advance before publication. Probe with interrupts
     * enabled; recheck READY/session below after taking the publication lock. */
    if ((NativeRuntime_ReadyGet() == 0U) || (NativeClock_ContextAllowedGet() == 0U))
    { return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_BUSY; }
    if (NativeClock_DelayUs(1U) != NativeClockResult_Ok)
    { return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_ERROR; }
'''+marker, 1)
    adapter = adapter[:start]+write+adapter[end:]
    if indexed:
        adapter = adapter.replace('hUsbDeviceFS.pClassData', 'hUsbDeviceFS.pClassDataCmsit[0]')
        marker='    if ((hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state != USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) ||'
        adapter = adapter.replace(marker,
            '    if ((hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state == USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) &&\n'
            '        ((hUsbDeviceFS.classId != 0U) || (hUsbDeviceFS.pClassDataCmsit[0] == NULL) ||\n'
            '         (hUsbDeviceFS.pClassData != hUsbDeviceFS.pClassDataCmsit[0])))\n'
            '    { NativeRuntime_TransportFaultRecord(); __set_PRIMASK(saved_mask); return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_ERROR; }\n'
            +marker, 1)
    return adapter

"""Owned private TIM1 compile probe; this deliberately is not Ground runtime."""
import hashlib,json,difflib,re
from types import SimpleNamespace
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_classic_cdc import NATIVE_PREFIX
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_clock import NativeClock_FilesRender

from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeHalDerivatives_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_no_heap import NativeNoHeap_FilesRender
from silverstar_fccg.generator.multi_target import _UserSection_Insert, _Makefile_Render


def NativeTimerProbe_FilesRender(native_files,proof,*,hclk_hz,scg_root):
    clock=NativeClockTimSourceContract_Inspect(native_files,proof['build']['sources'],hclk_hz=hclk_hz)
    files,replacements,hal=NativeHalDerivatives_Render(native_files,proof['build']['sources'])
    timer,timer_replacements,timer_manifest=NativeClockTimDerivatives_Render(native_files)
    files.update(timer);replacements.update(timer_replacements)
    config,config_include,config_manifest=NativeUsbConfig_FilesRender(native_files,proof['cdc']['owners'])
    files.update(config)
    files.update(NativeClock_FilesRender(hclk_hz=hclk_hz))
    files['Generated/Src/native_clock_port.c']=NativeClockTimPort_Render()
    api=scg_root/'plugins/builtin/silverstar_platform_api/payload/Platform/Inc'
    for path in api.glob('*.h'):files['Platform/Inc/'+path.name]=path.read_bytes()
    core=scg_root/'plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_0_1_0/payload'
    for path in ('Common/Inc/silverstar_assert.h','Common/Inc/silverstar_compiler.h',
        'Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c','Tools/check_power_of_ten.ps1'):
        files[path]=(core/path).read_bytes()
    heaps=[p for p in proof['build']['sources'] if p.endswith('/sysmem.c')]
    if len(heaps)!=1:raise ValueError('Native timer probe requires one reviewed heap extender')
    files.update(NativeNoHeap_FilesRender(native_files[heaps[0]]))
    replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+heaps[0]]='Generated/Src/native_no_heap.c'
    main_path=proof['cdc']['owners']['main.c'];main=native_files[main_path].decode('utf-8-sig')
    main=_UserSection_Insert(main,'Includes','#include "native_clock.h"\n#include "platform_time.h"',empty=True)
    main=_UserSection_Insert(main,'2','  if (PlatformTime_Init() != PLATFORM_OK) { Error_Handler(); }',empty=True)
    loop=re.findall(r'/\* USER CODE BEGIN 3 \*/(.*?)/\* USER CODE END 3 \*/',main,re.S)
    if len(loop)!=1 or loop[0].strip()!='}' or main.count('HAL_Init();')!=1:
        raise ValueError('Native timer probe refuses an existing owner loop')
    main=main.replace('HAL_Init();','if (HAL_Init() != HAL_OK) { Error_Handler(); }',1)
    main=main.replace('/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */','''/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */
    uint64_t now_us;
    if (NativeClock_Read(&now_us) != NativeClockResult_Ok) { Error_Handler(); }''',1)
    main_owned='HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeEntry/'+main_path;files[main_owned]=main.encode()
    replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+main_path]=main_owned
    linker_path=proof['build']['linker_script'];linker=native_files[linker_path].decode('utf-8-sig')
    heap=re.findall(r'(?m)^_Min_Heap_Size\s*=\s*(0x[\da-fA-F]+)\s*;',linker)
    if len(heap)!=1 or int(heap[0],16) not in (0,512):
        raise ValueError('Native timer linker heap reservation requires review')
    derived_linker=re.sub(r'(?m)^_Min_Heap_Size\s*=\s*0x[\da-fA-F]+\s*;',
        '_Min_Heap_Size = 0x0;',linker)
    owned_linker='HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeLinker/'+linker_path;files[owned_linker]=derived_linker.encode()
    linker_patch=owned_linker+'.patch'
    files[linker_patch]=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(linker.splitlines(keepends=True),derived_linker.splitlines(keepends=True),
        fromfile=NATIVE_PREFIX+linker_path,tofile=NATIVE_PREFIX+linker_path)).encode()
    graph={**proof['build'],'sources':[replacements.get(NATIVE_PREFIX+p,NATIVE_PREFIX+p) for p in proof['build']['sources']],
        'asm_sources':[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof['build']['asm_sources']],
        'include_dirs':[config_include,*[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof['build']['include_dirs']],
            'Generated/Inc','Platform/Inc','Common/Inc'],
        'linker_script':owned_linker,'required_irq_handlers':proof['required_irq_handlers'],
        'required_link_symbols':['_sbrk'],'native_timer_probe':True}
    # The rejecting heap owner already replaces native sysmem in the graph.
    # Append only additional owned sources; do not give that same file two
    # compilation owners or hide collisions between distinct object paths.
    graph['sources'] += [p for p in files if p.startswith(('Common/','Generated/'))
        and p.endswith('.c') and p not in graph['sources']]
    for name in ('native_machine_contract.py',):
        files['Tools/'+name]=(scg_root/'src/silverstar_fccg/hardware'/name).read_bytes()
    tools=scg_root/'plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_ground_0_1_0/payload/Tools'
    for name in ('check_native_ground.py','check_native_probe.py','ground_artifact_contract.py'):
        files['Tools/'+name]=(tools/name).read_bytes()
    records={'source_replacements':replacements,'original_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for p,v in native_files.items()},
        'compiled_owned_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(files[p]).hexdigest() for p in graph['sources'] if p in files},
        'clock':clock,'timer':timer_manifest,'hal':hal,'usb_config':config_manifest,
        'linker':{'original':NATIVE_PREFIX+linker_path,'derived':owned_linker,'patch':linker_patch,
            'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(native_files[linker_path]).hexdigest(),'derived_sha256':hashlib.sha256(files[owned_linker]).hexdigest()},
        'required_symbol_owners':{'HAL_InitTick':replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+'Core/Src/stm32f4xx_hal_timebase_tim.c'],
            'TIM1_UP_TIM10_IRQHandler':replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+'Core/Src/stm32f4xx_it.c'],
            'HAL_TIM_PeriodElapsedCallback':main_owned},
        'scope':'Private actual TIM1 clock/HAL/config compilation probe, NOT Ground runtime or EP0 acceptance',
        'critical_contract_review':'NOT PROVEN','runtime_generation':'BLOCKED'}
    files['Generated/native_probe_contract.json']=json.dumps(records,indent=2).encode()
    return files,graph,records


def NativeTimerProbe_MakeRender(graph,prefix):
    make=_Makefile_Render(tuple(graph['sources']),tuple(graph['asm_sources']),tuple(graph['include_dirs']),
        tuple(graph['defines']),SimpleNamespace(**graph),prefix)
    make=make.replace('-Wl,--gc-sections,','-Wl,-u,_sbrk -Wl,--gc-sections,',1)
    make=make.replace('$(PYTHON) Tools/check_ground.py architecture','$(PYTHON) Tools/check_native_probe.py architecture')
    make=make.replace('$(PYTHON) Tools/check_ground.py host','$(PYTHON) Tools/check_native_probe.py host')
    make=make.replace('$(PYTHON) Tools/check_ground.py artifact','$(PYTHON) Tools/check_native_probe.py artifact')
    # A probe has no Ground host program. Its actual owner/port fault cases are
    # run by pytest; the target explicitly refuses a fabricated host pass.
    return make

import hashlib
import difflib
import re
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_classic_cdc import NATIVE_PREFIX


def NativeUsbConfig_FilesRender(files, owners):
    expected=owners['usbd_conf.c'].removesuffix('.c')+'.h'
    paths=[p for p in files if p.rsplit('/',1)[-1]=='usbd_conf.h']
    if paths!=[expected]:raise ValueError('Native explicit USB config needs one header beside its LL owner')
    path=paths[0];original=files[path]
    if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()!='99dcff1bcbf4fbda59073bbc32ec34c61fbf7cbc0456c4f42b568078dee56fdf':
        raise ValueError('Native explicit USB configuration needs reviewed header source profile')
    source=original.decode('utf-8-sig')
    for name in ('USBD_CLASS_BOS_ENABLED','USBD_USER_REGISTER_CALLBACK'):
        if re.search(r'(?m)^\s*#\s*(?:define|undef)\s+'+name+r'\b',source):
            raise ValueError('Native explicit USB option has an existing owner: '+name)
    anchor='#define USBD_LPM_ENABLED     0U'
    if source.count(anchor)!=1:raise ValueError('Native USB configuration anchor changed')
    source=source.replace(anchor,anchor+'''
/* Private single-FS-CDC contract: no class BOS facility or user callback registry.
 * Both choices are explicit and compiled under the unchanged -Wundef policy. */
#define USBD_CLASS_BOS_ENABLED 0U
#define USBD_USER_REGISTER_CALLBACK 0U
''',1)
    target='HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeConfig/'+path;derived=source.encode()
    patch=target+'.patch'
    rendered={target:derived,patch:''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),
        source.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile=NATIVE_PREFIX+path,tofile=NATIVE_PREFIX+path)).encode()}
    manifest={'original':NATIVE_PREFIX+path,'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),
        'derived':target,'derived_sha256':hashlib.sha256(derived).hexdigest(),
        'patch':patch,'patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rendered[patch]).hexdigest(),
        'explicit_options':{'USBD_CLASS_BOS_ENABLED':0,'USBD_USER_REGISTER_CALLBACK':0},
        'scope':'Recognized native header profile only; retain static allocator and fixed native class callbacks'}
    return rendered,target.rsplit('/',1)[0],manifest
